basis: First actual original PNG observation, before context, old specs, or authored geometry exposure.

subfigures.description: Left lens profile: left boundary bows rightward into the lens, right boundary bows rightward more strongly; joined upper/lower tips; visibly thicker around the center than near either tip.

relationships.description: Two curved boundaries join at top and bottom to form a closed positive-meniscus-like profile.
Central thickness exceeds thickness near the joined upper and lower ends.

fineDetailHolds: Interior diagonal hatch marks are visible; exact individual stroke count is not reliably separable.

subfigures.description: Middle lens profile: left boundary bows leftward and right boundary bows rightward; joined tips; thicker centrally than near either tip.

relationships.description: Two outward-curved boundaries meet at the upper and lower tips to form a biconvex profile.
Central thickness exceeds thickness near the joined upper and lower ends.

fineDetailHolds: Interior diagonal hatch marks are visible; exact individual stroke count is not reliably separable.

subfigures.description: Right lens profile: nearly vertical straight left boundary and rightward-bowed curved right boundary; upper and lower joins; thicker centrally than near either end.

relationships.description: One straight and one convex boundary meet at both ends to form a plano-convex profile.
Central thickness exceeds thickness near the joined upper and lower ends.

fineDetailHolds: Interior diagonal hatch marks are visible; exact individual stroke count is not reliably separable.

relationships.description: One horizontal row of three widely separated upright profiles: meniscus-like, biconvex, plano-convex, left to right.
